entities.summary: James Kenneth Lefebvre is an American former professional infielder, coach, and manager in Major League Baseball (MLB). He won the National League Rookie of the Year in 1965 with the Los Angeles Dodgers as the team won the World Series. He started in the MLB All-Star Game the following season.
